item.title: Suez closure could last up to three weeks, marine insurers warn
item.dc:creator: Demo Desk
item.description: War-risk underwriters say the closure of the Suez Canal and the southern Red Sea could last up to three weeks while the incident is investigated; premiums for the route have doubled.

item.title: Suez Canal transits suspended after Red Sea security incident
item.dc:creator: Demo Desk
item.description: Southbound and northbound transits of the Suez Canal were halted early on Monday after a security incident in the southern Red Sea. Carriers on Asia–North Europe loops have paused bookings via the canal pending guidance.
